translations.web: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
translations.bsb: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace with those he met each day.
translations.kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
translations.asv: So he reasoned in the synagogue with Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with them that met him.
